test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 27 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two trains of length 120 m and 280 m are running towards each other on parallel lines at 42 km/h and 30 km/h, respectively. In how much time will they be clear of each other from the moment they meet?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of Train 1 = 120 m

Length of Train 2 = 280 m

Speed of Train 1 = 42 km/h

Speed of Train 2 = 30 km/h

**Formula used:**

Relative Speed when two objects move towards each other = Sum of their speeds

Time = Distance / Speed

**Calculation:**

Convert speeds from km/h to m/s:

Speed of Train 1

⇒ 42 km/h = 42 × (5/18) m/s = 35/3 m/s

Speed of Train 2

⇒ 30 km/h = 30 × (5/18) m/s = 25/3 m/s

Relative Speed

⇒ (35/3 + 25/3) m/s = 60/3 m/s = **20 m/s**

Total Distance to be covered

⇒ 120 m + 280 m = 400 m

⇒ Time = Distance / Speed

⇒ Time = 400 m / 20 m/s

⇒ Time = 20 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is option (3).**
